title: Scope.
officialText:
Deep foundation elements, including but not limited to piles, caisson piles, and helical piles, shall comply with Section
1808. In addition, driven piles shall comply with Section 1809; cast-in-place concrete piles shall comply with Section 1810; composite piles shall comply with Section 1811; and helical piles shall comply with Section 1812.
